'''Markus Wuest Hunt The Jedi''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Markus Wuest]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds56.htm Hunt The Jedi], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228072859/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds56.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Markus Wuest]]
